answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The jetty of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the basalt until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the velvet of the next round. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
